# UserAvatar

The signed-in user: an initial pill, the name, the role indicator ("Lead") and an optional notification counter. Per the Specs User Avatar (111-227876). - `spacing="compact"` is 32 high (`--item-height-md`), for the 32 topbar. The name truncates at `--label-max-width`. - `spacing="default"` pads `--pad-y-md` around a 32 pill, for table rows.

Also asked as: user picture, tutor photo, student photo.

**Import:** `import { UserAvatar } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/images-and-icons/UserAvatar/UserAvatar.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/images-and-icons/UserAvatar/UserAvatar.stories.jsx` — Overview, Spacing, Types, Counter, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, Focused, Disabled

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/images-and-icons/UserAvatar/UserAvatar.mdx`

## Usage

Use `UserAvatar` for the current user's identity in the topbar or in a row that names a person. For a person who is not the signed-in user, or a picture-only avatar, use `Avatar`.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Show the name as the person wrote it. | Shorten the name yourself; the row truncates it. |
| Keep the counter to the number of unread items. | Put text, or a count over 99, in the counter. |

## Best practices

### Pick `spacing` by where it sits. {#pick-spacing-by-where-it-sits}

`compact` fits the 32 topbar. `default` fits table rows. The name truncates with an ellipsis, at the label maximum width in `compact`, and keeps the full name in its `title`.

Do: Compact in the 32 topbar.
Don't: Default, which is too tall for the topbar.

### Pass `onClick` to make it clickable. {#pass-onclick-to-make-it-clickable}

Without it the avatar is a static line. With it, the row shows the pointer, takes focus, and presses on Enter (keydown) and Space (keyup). When the click opens a menu or navigates, wrap the avatar in the button or link that owns that behavior instead, so the control carries its own name and expanded state.

Do: An onClick makes the row a control, with focus and press.
Don't: A static row where a click is expected.

### Show the full name. {#show-the-full-name}

The name is what tells two people apart.

Do: The full name, with its first letter on the avatar.
Don't: Initials as the name, which tell nobody apart.

## Accessibility

- **A clickable row is a button.** With `onClick` it has `role="button"`, a tab stop, and a 2px focus ring. `state="disabled"` keeps the role, sets `aria-disabled` and removes the tab stop. The counter is read with its unit ("2 notifications").
- **The initial is decorative.** The pill is hidden from assistive technology; the name carries the meaning.
- **The role is text.** The Lead tag is a Status tag with visible text, not color alone.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `firstChar` | string | `'J'` | The initial shown in the pill. |
| `name` | string | `'John Doe'` | The user's name. Truncates with an ellipsis; at the label maximum width in the compact spacing. |
| `counter` | bool | `true` | Show the notification counter. |
| `counterValue` | number | `2` | The number in the counter. |
| `state` | enum | `'enabled'` | Forces the hover look, for docs, or dims the row as disabled. |
| `type` | enum | `'regular tutor'` | The user type. `lead tutor` adds the Lead status tag. |
| `spacing` | enum | `'default'` | `compact` is 32 high, for the topbar. `default` is padded, for table rows. |
| `id` | string | — | — |
| `onClick` | func | — | — |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
